title: Injured HP and bar survive stock Save and cartridge reload

verification.actor: One current Wild Onix (species 95) at Route 29 tile (585,412); player at (585,407).
verification.trigger: Onix builds Ram speed and one hit lowers HP to 67. Normal buttons save through the stock menu, then a private cartridge reload loads those written bytes.
verification.observable: The authenticated Save app reaches state 12 and completes. Exported and loaded private cartridge hashes match. HP and saved HP remain 67, with native bar fill 30 after reload.

setupMutations.change: Checked teleport to Route 29, native Wild Onix spawn, and exact live identity bind. No HP or save data is edited.
No direct game-state mutation. Normal menu input writes the private cartridge; save.reload exports and reloads its bytes.

limits: Prepared Onix placement tests real Ram damage, not natural population spawn selection.
The Save menu path uses the observed button sequence and a bounded native wait only for the stock state-12 flash write.
Matching private cartridge hashes and HP after reload prove persistence; no user save or original fixture is changed.
Native bar submission is measured, not final LCD pixels or color appearance.
A missing stock write, changed exported bytes, wrong HP, wrong bar fill, or incomplete field boundary fails.

events.value: Place and bind one current Wild Onix.
Normal Ram damage, stock Save write, and private cartridge reload retain injured HP.

stop.condition: Written and reloaded private cartridge has HP 67 and bar fill 30, or the first invalid native receipt.

invariants: One current Wild Onix causes Ram damage
Loaded cartridge bytes match the export
